question: Do a small number of causally ordered downstream response groups jointly account for the MLP8-complement route, including its opposing late correction, without treating overlapping singleton removals as additive?

prior_art.finding: Attention9 removes 84-86% of behavior. Attention11/15 and MLP9-15 are smaller positive responses, while MLP17 is an opposing correction. Singleton fractions overlap and therefore cannot be summed.
prior_art.novelty: First exact all-subset causal factorial over predeclared downstream module groups under the frozen MLP8 complement actuation.

frozen_design.population: The same 29 jointly capable fresh-v6 A1/A2 rows and exact MLP8 post-cue Down-orthogonal complement as the released atlas.
frozen_design.arms: All 16 subsets of the four groups, plus the complete 18-site clamp and native self-clamp. Groups are installed together in causal module order by simultaneous response clamping.
frozen_design.metrics: Removed donorward answer/foil behavior and final-Q8 coordinates relative to the live complement route, reported per panel. Also report exact subset marginals and nonadditivity.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_self_clamp_finit: All hashes, parent replay, empty-subset replay, complete clamp, self-clamp, finite metrics, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_four_group_program_is_near_comple: The four-group union removes at least 95% absolute behavior and 90% Q8 norm, with behavior/Q8 cosine at least .95 in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_attention_core_is_dominant: Core attention alone removes at least 75% behavior and 75% Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_late_bank_is_an_opposing_correcti: The late-bank marginal after core+auxiliary+positive groups has negative signed behavior fraction in both panels and absolute magnitude at least .03 in at least one.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_exact_group_inventory: Every group and all 16 subsets are evaluated with no fit, gradients, rank search, or model update.

decision: Screen licenses localization/weight compilation only within groups with material conditional marginals. A null preserves the exact factorial and redirects group boundaries from the observed interactions; it does not license summing singleton atlas effects.
